name: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE
unit: NGN, printed in millions (N millions) and stored absolute (x1000000 = whole Naira)
scale_note: The prospectus states the Naira statements in 'million; multiplied by 1000000 here, the whole-currency unit the other statement files in this tree use. The same statements are also printed in US$ '000 in the prospectus (pages 75 to 76); the Naira columns are used to match the NGX convention.
listing_status: Not listed. SEC-approved offer for subscription open 14 September to 13 October 2026; listing on the NGX Main Board indicated for late November to early December 2026 and NOT fixed. There is no traded price and no market capitalisation; the offer/subscription price is recorded in offerPrice, which is not a share price and is not a market capitalisation.
source: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE, Initial Public Offering Prospectus dated 07 September 2026, Operating and Financial Review, Liquidity and Capital Resources net cash flow table, page 91 (Naira 'million; also printed in US$ '000). H1 2026 is the six months ended 30 June 2026; FY2025 to FY2021 are the years ended 31 December.

rows.label: Operating Cash Flow
rows.note: Net cash generated from/(used in) operating activities. FY2024 was negative (a working-capital build in the first year of operations).

rows.label: Net Cash Used In Investing Activities
rows.note: H1 2026 is positive (matured deposits); every full year is a net outflow.

rows.label: Net Cash (Used In)/Generated From Financing Activities
Net Change in Cash
rows.note: Net increase/(decrease) in cash and cash equivalents.

rows.label: Cash And Cash Equivalents At Beginning Of Year/Period
Effect Of Exchange Rate Movements On Cash Balances
Cash And Cash Equivalents At End Of Year/Period
rows.source: page 91; equals the Cash & Equivalents line at page 75

identityChecks: Operating + Investing + Financing net cash = Net Change in Cash
Opening cash + Net Change in Cash + Exchange movement = Closing cash
Closing cash = balance sheet Cash and cash equivalents
projectionNote: No projection is carried. The prospectus states planned capital expenditure of US$4.8bn for the remainder of 2026, US$3.9bn in 2027 and US$3.1bn in 2028 (pages 34 and 156) and a US$14.3bn expansion to 1.4m barrels per day. Those are estimates of future spend, not results, and are deliberately excluded from this statement.
roundingNote: Three columns carry a one-unit rounding difference in the prospectus's own printed table, carried unchanged and not adjusted: H1 2026, the three net cash flows sum to 4,284,912m against a printed net change of 4,284,911m; FY2024, they sum to 136,464m against a printed net change of 136,465m, and opening cash plus the net change plus the exchange movement gives 483,614m against a printed closing cash of 483,613m; FY2021, they sum to (363)m against a printed net change of (362)m, and opening cash plus the net change gives 180m against a printed closing cash of 179m. Every other column ties exactly.
reconciliation_note: The printed table ties on every column except the one-unit rounding differences recorded in roundingNote: opening cash plus the net change plus the effect of exchange rate movements equals closing cash, and closing cash equals the balance sheet cash line. Source: prospectus dated 07 September 2026, page 91.
market_cap_withheld_reason: Withheld: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE has not listed. The SEC-approved offer for subscription runs 14 September to 13 October 2026 and the NGX Main Board listing is indicated for late November to early December 2026 and is NOT fixed, so the company has no traded price and no market capitalisation. A market-based multiple cannot be built from a price that does not exist. A blank is honest; a number standing in for a price that has never traded is not.
